findings.title: Continuous labor becomes protected preservation
findings.claim: Sustained sowing and harvesting meet the deliberate act of leaving the grain in its ear, so production is carried forward as protected preservation before scarcity can consume it.
findings.mechanism: The focus actions of cultivating, persisting, harvesting, and leaving contact one another, while the literal ear supplies the enclosing form and 12:49's later pressing supplies a return to processing. The contact changes the plan from production followed by immediate use into production joined to protected delay.
findings.reader_payoff: The instruction becomes a complete preservation procedure: labor produces the reserve, leaving keeps it in a protective form, and later processing remains available.
findings.containment: This is a macro-contextual synthesis of the supplied agricultural images. It preserves the plain instruction to sow, harvest, leave the grain in its ear, and eat only a little; it does not turn the word for ear into a general storage theory or claim that every later use is part of the same image.

epistemic.reason: The channel evidence is trusted and its focus carriers are explicit, but the enclosed-grain branch is supplied as a nominated source image rather than a registered lexical record.
